title: SMOK RPM C Pod Vape Kit
description: The Smok RPM C pod kit is a powerful, stylish and versatile device that delivers a satisfying vaping experience for both MTL (mouth-to-lung) and DTL (direct-to-lung) fans. Compatible with Smok’s range of RPM 2 coils , you can choose the perfect coil resistance to suit your preferred style. Powered by a built-in 1650mAh battery, the RPM C kit delivers a consistent and powerful vaping experience, while smart wattage technology ensures optimal output for your coil of choice. The RPM C is a user-friendly device with a simple yet elegant single-button design that makes operation a breeze. The device automatically detects the selected coil, taking the guesswork out of vaping. The RPM C also features a stepless airflow control toggle that lets you adjust the draw with ease. Useful data such as battery life and wattage are displayed on a crystal-clear OLED screen , below which are up/down buttons for adjusting your settings. The RPM C pods have a 2ml capacity and are compatible with RPM 2 coils, making it easy to experiment with different vaping styles. The kit includes a 0.16ohm coil suitable for sub-ohm vaping and a 0.6ohm coil ideal for MTL vaping/ The RPM 2 coils feature a mesh build that heats e-liquid faster, resulting in improved flavour and an exceptional vaping experience. Others in the RPM 2 series are the RPM 2 0.3 Ohm coil which produces voluminous clouds, ideal for cloud-chasers, and works best with e-liquid that has a minimum of 70% VG . The RPM 2 DC-0.6 Ohm coil delivers a more restricted MTL inhale with 50% VG or high-PG vape e-liquid. To refill your pod, simply remove the top to access the fill port. With its sleek and compact design, the Smok RPM C pod kit is perfect for both new and experienced vapers who want a powerful, portable and user-friendly device that delivers excellent performance and exceptional. Discover our vape juice online and find a flavour that complements this kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
